profile.name: 虚拟CAN总线
profile.description: 基于内部消息队列的非物理虚拟CAN总线组件，用于测试和仿真。它通过任意通道标识连接多个软件总线实例，在同一逻辑通道上传递CAN消息，提供可靠的消息投递与顺序保证，但不直接连接或控制真实硬件设备。
profile.description_en: A non-physical virtual CAN bus component based on an internal message queue, intended for testing and simulation. It connects multiple software bus instances through an arbitrary channel identifier and passes CAN messages on the same logical channel, providing reliable delivery and message ordering without directly interfacing with real hardware.

registry.name: Virtual Bus
registry.description: Virtual BUS是一款实验执行&合成设备。支持Signal, Slot, send等操作。
